items.title: Eddie Johnson Interview, 1962-11-06
items.q: David Jones and Tim and myself on the outro... That's what I just did, Matoya and David Jones.

ctx.x: You were leading that band with Matoya? No, I'm in the twine. Matoya? No, no. Oh no, another time. I see. I'm in managing. Who was in that band with Matoya?
David Jones and Tim and myself on the outro. William Foster playing the banjo.
